blocks.html:
Nothing compares to the joy of spending time with our grandparents. They guide us with their wisdom, inspire us with their stories, and surround us with love and warmth.

This September, Robinsons Land Corporation’s Robinsons Malls invites families to honor our beloved Lolos and Lolas with a special celebration filled with fun, music, special treats, and bonding moments.

blocks.cap: Treat Lolo and Lola to a heartwarming meal at Paradise Dynasty

blocks.html: Kick off the festivities by challenging your grandparents to a friendly round of fun games such as Chess, Scrabble, and other tabletop favorites. Strike a pose at the photo corners and photobooths, where every smile becomes a printed keepsake.

blocks.cap: Belt out classics at the Karaoke Hub in Robinsons Galleria

blocks.html: The malls will come alive with acoustic performances and busking sessions, inviting grandparents to sing along with the performers. To make the moment even sweeter, each participating grandparent will receive a Robinsons Movieworld voucher. Families looking for a more private bonding moment can also head to the Karaoke Hub at Robinsons Galleria for an intimate singing session.

blocks.cap: Feast in Style at Il Lupino Prime in Opus
Flavorful hotpot at Haidilao in Robinsons Galleria

blocks.html: After the fun and games, treat them to a culinary feast across Robinsons Malls’ diverse dining destinations such as Haidilao in Robinsons Galleria, Vikings Luxury Buffet in Robinsons Antipolo, Breakfast at Antonio’s and Paradise Dynasty in Robinsons Magnolia, Via Mare and Il Lupino Prime at Opus, Ribshack in Robinsons Galleria Cebu, Tia Tita’s in Robinsons Tacloban and Annipie Bakery Cafe in Robinsons Tagum.

blocks.cap: Filipino comfort food awaits at Via Mare in Opus

blocks.html: Shoppers with receipts worth PHP 3,500 from September 13-14, 2025, can claim exclusive rewards such as Robinsons Movieworld gift certificates. Families can also enjoy the Buy 2 Tickets, Get 1 Free promo at Robinsons Movieworld, perfect for enjoying the big screen together.

blocks.cap: Enjoy grand movie moments with 45% off on tickets at Robinsons Movieworld
Get your rib fix at Ribshack in Robinsons Galleria Cebu, Robinsons Fuente, and Robinsons Cybergate Cebu
Brunch made special at Breakfast at Antonio’s in Robinsons Magnolia & Opus
Indulge in a luxurious buffet at Vikings in Robinsons Antipolo
Grandparents Day made sweeter at Matcha Tokyo in Robinsons Magnolia and Opus

blocks.html: To help grandparents stay safe and confident in today's digital world, Robinsons Malls is partnering with GoTyme for Tech Talks for Lolo and Lola this Grandparents Day weekend. Join the sessions on September 13 at Robinsons Galleria and September 14 at Robinsons Galleria South

blocks.cap: Treat them to the famous 8-flavored Xiao Long Bao at Paradise Dynasty

blocks.html:
This Grandparents Day, make every moment truly RGrand at Robinsons Malls.

For more information, please visit the official Robinsons Malls Facebook and Instagram pages or download the RMalls+ app.
